title: Harnessing in vitro cytotoxicity and antibacterial potential of a novel silver-DABCO framework against multi-drug-resistant pathogens
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,8180-8188
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00509D, Paper

Shivaprasad Shivappa Desai, K. A. Deepika Roy, Padikkamannil Abishad, Rahul Krishnan, Valil Kunjukunju Vinod, Asha Karthikeyan, Plantharayil Bharathan Aswathi, Sanis Juliet, Sukhadeo Baliram Barbuddhe, Deepak Bhiwa Rawool, Jess Vergis
This study aimed to synthesize and characterize silver-based metal–organic frameworks (Ag-MOFs) using 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane (DABCO) as the organic ligand and to assess their antibacterial and cytotoxic properties.
